final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), above_avg AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, AVG(order_count) OVER () AS above_avg_count FROM account_orders WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_orders)) SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_orders) AS above_account_average, order_count - above_avg_count AS above_above_average_average FROM above_avg ORDER BY above_above_average_average DESC LIMIT 10
